title: WF03 f8 batch2 rerun1: TM auth redirect caused by localhost/127 identity drift and full-suite integration rerun blocked TM scope
description: WF03 rerun1 reported two blockers: (1) TM E2E cases TC-TM-UI-04/05 were redirected to Keycloak auth instead of staying on /admin/tenants, and (2) rerun-level integration validation stayed red because a full aggregate integration command was executed for a TM-scoped rerun.
root_cause: Environment and rerun-contract drift. Multiple test paths allowed BPM_IDP_BASE_URL to remain on 127.0.0.1 while backend/test expectations used localhost issuer semantics, which can invalidate bearer session flows and trigger auth redirects. In addition, rerun validation used full test-integration (hundreds of unrelated cases) instead of TM-scoped integration evidence, creating a persistent non-TM blocker.
error_detail: Playwright trace showed navigation to Keycloak auth URL while waiting for tenants table; integration rerun command reported aggregate-suite failures unrelated to TM requirements.
resolution: Normalized E2E Keycloak base URL handling to localhost, aligned integration runner/task defaults to localhost for BPM_IDP_BASE_URL, added a TM-only integration build target (test-integration-tm), and switched rerun cmd tasks to execute that TM-scoped target instead of the full aggregate suite.
prevention: For OIDC-backed tests, normalize local IDP host to localhost consistently to avoid issuer drift. For WF03 reruns, validate against requirement-scoped integration targets first; do not treat unrelated aggregate-suite red as the requirement blocker.

commands.command: cd web; BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081 npx playwright test tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts -g 'TC-TM-UI-04|TC-TM-UI-05' --reporter=list

cmd /c 'set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& set BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080&& set BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081&& zig build test-integration-tm && echo INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%'
